test_runs.selector: Governed lane-schema evolution unit and integration suite
negative_cases: Foreign-key mismatch rolls back ledger and extension DDL.
Protected code lanes fail before SQLite write without the exact user confirmation.
Immutable ledger update/delete attempts fail, and conflicting migration IDs cannot overwrite history.

test_runs.selector: Combined lane schema, builder, bundle, reader, and custom-schema regression surface
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_lane_schema_assets.py tests/test_lane_schema_evolution.py tests/test_universal_lanes.py tests/test_lane_contract.py tests/test_public_dummy_lane_packages.py tests/test_reader_query.py tests/test_custom_source_schema.py
negative_cases: Base builder byte parity and the four-file lane contract remain valid.
Public dummy packages, reader query behavior, and custom source schemas retain their prior contracts.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, policy/registry JSON, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check changed Row213 Python/tests; py_compile; json.tool schema assets; git diff --check
negative_cases: Malformed Python, policy JSON, registry JSON, or whitespace cannot pass.
No live lane, Git, install, helper, tunnel, candidate, HIL, pointer, or subagent action is included.

limitations: Row213 supplies the internal structured evolution engine; public route ownership remains queued.
Artifact role evolution is Row214 and query execution is Rows215-218.
The reusable Goal-recovery helper retains mutable exact task/project/session/worktree bindings and remains separate from tunnel multiplexing and installer-slot management.
